en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a historic stone wall and tower structure, with pronounced arches and a steeply pitched roof topped by a spire. There is a wooden staircase and gate leading up to an entrance in the wall, with two children standing at the gate. To the right are some old houses, blending into the monumental medieval architecture, suggesting the setting is in or near an old city center.
